verdict.rationale: Motion documents its own public API, available to all users, for creating, updating and managing projects and tasks. The API has a full endpoint reference and cookbooks, so scripts can automate it without the UI. There is no evidence of a CLI, a CI integration, or guidance for running it in pipelines. Headless use is only implied through raw API calls. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, CI/pipeline docs or examples, service-account/token auth guidance for automation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
